diagnosis: Model outputs 1.0 for every word segment regardless of threshold. positive_class_weight=5.0 caused saturation. The 15-dim per-word features lack temporal context — model cannot distinguish individual word laugh markers from surrounding speech. RECOMMENDATION: Add bidirectional LSTM/GRU temporal context layer on top of 15-dim prosody features.
key_insight: Word-level prosody alone (no temporal context) is insufficient. The model needs sequence context to identify laugh segments vs speech with similar features.
